description:
Are you interested in revolutionizing how hundreds of millions of people utilize their devices to access information? As an engineer on the team, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge foundation models and the end user, helping guide the products and features that bring our generative AI technologies to life. 

Description
In this role, you will be the critical engineering link between backend machine learning and the final user interface. You will be responsible for designing and implementing intelligent user experiences that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs). To make these experiences fast, accurate, and context-aware, you will integrate with data and services from multiple providers, building the complex orchestration layer required for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). You will work closely with our platform team to define the infrastructure interfaces necessary for low-latency model serving and secure data handling. Because you bring strong product thinking to the room, you will also partner directly with Apple Design and client-side teams to ensure a great user experience, translating complex AI interactions into flawless, intuitive features across Siri, Spotlight, and Safari.


Responsibilities
 Engineering Model-Driven Products: Leverage the latest advancements in machine learning by building the robust software application layer that translates foundation model capabilities into intuitive, generative user experiences.
Complex Integrations & Privacy: Orchestrate ML APIs with internal data and services to power RAG architectures, ensuring all integrations maintain Apple's high standards for secure, direct, and privacy-preserving data handling.
Championing the User Experience: Partner closely with design, product, and client-side teams to craft elegant solutions for emerging generative UI paradigms, ensuring fluid text streaming, dynamic widget generation, and graceful fallbacks.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with diverse teams—including ML infrastructure, quality, data, and core platform—to define system contracts, ensuring optimal latency, robust error handling, and scalable orchestration.
Evaluation & Telemetry Tooling: Develop the engineering frameworks, benchmark tooling, and telemetry required to accurately measure, calibrate, and evaluate the real-time performance and quality of model responses in production.
Global Reach & Mentorship: Work with the globalization team to ensure localized, culturally aligned experiences, and mentor aspiring engineers to broaden their horizons and amplify the team's overall impact.

Minimum qualifications
3+ years of industry related experience, working in collaborative environments
Experience with prompt engineering and prompt tuning techniques to tasks, conducting systematic evaluation and iteration based on quality and consistency metrics.
Opinionated product-sense and focus on the end user-experience
Excellent problem solving, critical thinking, and communication skills
Proficient in at least two programming languages such as: C/C++, Go, Python, Java
Understanding product requirements then translating them into engineering tasks
Bachelors in Computer Science or related field or 2 years of equivalent work experience


Preferred qualifications
Prior experience in consumer facing product is desired
In-depth experience with server-side development and deployment
Advanced degree in CS
